content.title: Sub-Area Planning: Square Lake
content.summary: The Square Lake Sub-Area Plan, a collaborative effort with Adams County, encompasses the area east of Sheridan Boulevard to Tennyson Street, between 52nd and 60th Avenues. The Arvada City Council approved the final plan in August 2022, with additional details available on the Adams County sub-area plan website.
content.body:
## Square Lake Sub-Area Plan

The Square Lake Sub-Area is a collaborative project with Adams County that is generally defined as the area east of Sheridan Boulevard to Tennyson Street between 52nd Avenue on the south and 60th Avenue on the north. The City of Arvada portion of the Square Lake area is generally located east of Sheridan Boulevard to Tennyson Street between 58th Avenue and 60th Avenue.

The Arvada City Council adopted the final [Square Lake Sub-Area Plan (PDF)](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68c12a5a37fc7) in August of 2022. For further information about the plan, visit the [Adams County sub-area plan website](https://adcogov.org/square-lake-subarea-plan).
